name: astable-25khz
prompt: Build a 555 astable oscillator running at 25 kHz from a 9 V supply, with the output brought to a labelled net called PWM_OUT.
notes: Same equation as the blinkers but three decades up in frequency, so the component-value regime changes (nF and single-digit kilohms). A stock blinker answer misses by orders of magnitude.
